name: Leftovers
mainline_effect: Restores 1/16 max HP at the end of every turn
activation: End of turn while holder is active and not fainted
strategic_role: Sustain for bulky Pokémon; strongest generic defensive item in this format

name: Sitrus Berry
champions_status: Reported legal (GPM); not named by CD/VGC
mainline_effect: Restores 1/4 max HP when HP falls to 1/2 or less; consumed
activation: After a hit leaves holder at <=50% HP
coop_adaptation: Not consumed from the bag: once per battle then restored
strategic_role: Burst recovery; strong because battles here are long

name: Focus Sash
mainline_effect: At full HP survives a hit that would KO with 1 HP; consumed
activation: A single hit that would KO from full HP
coop_adaptation: Not consumed from the bag; multi-hit second hit can still KO (mainline)
strategic_role: Anti-OHKO insurance; matters in casual Level gaps more than at Lv 50

name: Choice Band
mainline_effect: Attack x1.5; holder locked into its first chosen move until it leaves the field
coop_adaptation: Lock lasts until the holder faints (no switching in Coop battles)
strategic_role: Physical power at the cost of flexibility

name: Choice Specs
strategic_role: Special power at the cost of flexibility

name: Choice Scarf
strategic_role: Outspeed threats; lets slow hitters move first

name: Eviolite
mainline_effect: Defense and Sp. Def x1.5 if the holder can still evolve
strategic_role: Makes unevolved/low-tier Pokémon viable; helps newcomers most

name: Muscle Band
strategic_role: Mild physical boost without a lock

name: Wise Glasses
strategic_role: Mild special boost without a lock

name: Shell Bell
activation: After the holder's move deals damage

name: Quick Claw
mainline_effect: 20% chance to move first within its priority bracket
coop_adaptation: Random draw only when a holder is active (keeps no-item battles identical)
strategic_role: Luck-based speed; S-tier in Champions doubles, modest here

name: Black Sludge
mainline_effect: Poison types heal 1/16 per turn; others lose 1/8
strategic_role: Poison-type Leftovers; trap for others (UI must warn)

name: Light Ball
mainline_effect: Pikachu: Attack and Sp. Atk x2

name: Thick Club
strategic_role: Makes Marowak a strong pick; watch at Lv 50

name: Metal Powder
coop_adaptation: Ditto has no Transform in Coop battles; effect is a flat Defense boost on a 288-BST Pokémon

name: Soul Dew
mainline_effect: Latias/Latios: Psychic and Dragon moves x1.2 (Gen 7+)
strategic_role: Boosts two legendaries: no launch value for balance

name: Life Orb
champions_status: Absent at launch; added in Reg M-B
mainline_effect: Damage x1.3; holder loses 1/10 max HP after each damaging move
activation: After each attack that deals damage
strategic_role: Glass-cannon damage; a TRAP in Coop's long battles
launch_recommendation: Defer: net negative here; revisit with format data

name: Rocky Helmet
champions_status: Conflicting: absent at launch (Game Rant); CD lists 1000 VP
mainline_effect: Contact attackers lose 1/6 of their max HP
activation: Each contact hit on the holder
coop_adaptation: Candidate nerf: once per battle (74.8% all-6) or 1/8
strategic_role: Punishes physical attackers; OUTLIER here because the AI never avoids contact
launch_recommendation: Defer: needs a Coop-specific nerf approved first

name: Assault Vest
mainline_effect: Sp. Def x1.5; holder cannot use status moves
coop_adaptation: Coop has no status moves, so the drawback does nothing
strategic_role: Would be a free stat boost
launch_recommendation: Defer: drawback inert in this engine

name: Scope Lens
coop_adaptation: Coop crit is x2 (Gen 5) not x1.5: stage +1 = 1/8

name: Zoom Lens
mainline_effect: Accuracy x1.2 when moving after the target

name: Metronome
mainline_effect: +20% power per consecutive use of the same move (max x2)
strategic_role: Rewards mono-move attackers; pairs with AI's best-move pick
launch_recommendation: Phase 2 (balance check: AI repeats moves a lot)

name: Focus Band
mainline_effect: 10% chance to survive a KO hit with 1 HP
coop_adaptation: Random draw only when holder is hit for a KO

name: King's Rock
activation: On hit, if holder moved first

name: Air Balloon
mainline_effect: Ground immunity until hit by any attack
coop_adaptation: Pops on first hit; restored after battle

name: Mental Herb
coop_adaptation: No such effects exist in Coop battles

name: White Herb
coop_engine_class: 3 substantial (stat stages exist only in the Mega/ability engine)
coop_adaptation: Only Intimidate-like abilities lower stats today

name: Lum Berry
mainline_effect: Cures any non-volatile status or confusion; consumed
strategic_role: None until a status system exists

name: Rawst Berry
coop_adaptation: Burn exists only via abilities (Mega engine)

name: Figy Berry (and Wiki/Mago/Aguav/Iapapa)
mainline_effect: Restore 1/3 max HP at <=25% HP; confuses if nature dislikes the flavor
coop_adaptation: No natures in Coop: confusion clause dropped (documented adaptation)

name: Occa Berry (and the 17 other type-resist berries)
mainline_effect: Halves one super-effective hit of its type (Chilan: any Normal hit); consumed
launch_recommendation: Phase 2 (18 items; tie to type coverage UI)

name: Charcoal (and the 17 other type boosters)
mainline_effect: Moves of its type x1.2 power
coop_adaptation: None. Catalog id charcoal already exists as defined

name: Damp Rock / Heat Rock / Smooth Rock / Icy Rock
coop_adaptation: Weather exists only via Mega abilities
launch_recommendation: Not recommended (revisit with Mega weather teams)

name: Electric/Grassy/Misty/Psychic Seed
coop_adaptation: Only Electric Terrain exists (one Mega ability)

name: Weakness Policy
coop_adaptation: Stat stages exist only in the ability engine

name: Clear Amulet
coop_adaptation: Stat stages only in ability engine

name: Safety Goggles
coop_adaptation: Sand chip only via Mega Tyranitar etc.

name: Booster Energy
coop_adaptation: Ordinary Pokémon have no abilities in Coop

name: Flame Orb / Toxic Orb
mainline_effect: Burns/poisons the holder at end of turn
coop_adaptation: Needs Guts-style abilities to have any upside

name: Mega Stones (81 in Reg M-C)
mainline_effect: Enable Mega Evolution; occupy the item slot
coop_adaptation: Coop consumes the stone to unlock; see decision D-H5 on whether a Mega's item slot is occupied
